name: code-enhance
description: Run five explicit, evidence-driven, strictly read-only code review specialties for aesthetics, simplification, performance and idioms, design, and security.

interface.shortDescription: Five auditable, read-only code review specialties.
interface.longDescription: Review repositories, current development changes, directories, and version evolution through five explicit specialties: code aesthetics, simplification, performance and idiomatic implementation, design patterns and boundaries, and security. Every specialty uses complete coverage ledgers, isolated discovery, fresh evidence validation, and a strict read-only boundary.
defaultPrompt: Use $code-enhance:beautify to review my current changes for code aesthetics and readability.
Use $code-enhance:simplify to find unnecessary complexity in my current changes.
Use $code-enhance:standardize to review my current changes for performance and idiomatic code improvements.
Use $code-enhance:design to review my current changes for design-pattern and boundary fitness.
Use $code-enhance:security to review my current changes for exploitable security risks.
